# Max Scopp -- Mobile Autoaufbereitung in Prüm

> Mobile Fahrzeugaufbereitung in Prüm und Umgebung. Innenraumreinigung,
> Außenpflege, Lackaufbereitung und individuell abgestimmte Extras --
> direkt beim Kunden zu Hause oder am Arbeitsplatz.

## Website

-   Homepage: https://auto.maxscopp.de/
-   Kundenprojekt -- Baily, Leas BMW 1er:
    https://auto.maxscopp.de/lea-bmw-aufbereitung.html
-   Impressum: https://auto.maxscopp.de/impressum.html
-   Datenschutz: https://auto.maxscopp.de/datenschutz.html

## Business overview

Max Scopp offers mobile car detailing in Prüm and the surrounding area
in Germany. The service is performed at the customer's location, such as
home or workplace. Customers should ask whether their specific location
is within the service area.

-   Contact: https://auto.maxscopp.de/
-   Phone / WhatsApp: +49 176 5550 5700
-   Booking: Contact by WhatsApp or phone. Share the vehicle model,
    desired service, and ideally photos to receive an initial
    assessment.
-   On-site requirements: Water is needed; electricity is not. Water use
    is usually no more than roughly half a bathtub.
-   Work scope, timing, and any additional costs are discussed with the
    customer in advance.

## Services and indicative prices

Prices below are starting points for small cars through compact-class
vehicles. Vehicle size, condition, and scope can affect the final price.

### Frisch --- from €90

Interior **or** exterior service; approximately 1.5--2 hours.

-   Exterior option: hand wash, wheels, tires, and windows.
-   Interior option: vacuuming, surfaces, and windows.
-   Eligible mothers with children under 14 receive a 20% discount;
    indicated starting price after discount: €72.

### Familie --- from €200

Interior and exterior service with steam cleaning where suitable;
approximately 3--4 hours.

-   Includes the Frisch interior and exterior work.
-   Also includes upholstery, ventilation areas, crevices, and one child
    seat.
-   Eligible mothers with children under 14 receive a 20% discount;
    indicated starting price after discount: €160.

### Wie neu --- from €500

Comprehensive detailing; approximately one day.

-   Includes the Familie package.
-   Adds deep cleaning, polishing, and paint protection/sealing.
-   Eligible mothers with children under 14 receive a 20% discount;
    indicated starting price after discount: €400.

### Additional services

-   Rain-repellent visibility treatment is available as an add-on.
-   Individual extras can be discussed, including dashcam or radio
    installation, wiring, and removal work.
-   Parts, pricing, and scope for extras are agreed in advance.
-   Steam is used only when appropriate for the relevant material.

## Approach and products

-   Care is selected to suit the material and task, including textiles,
    leather, and paint.
-   Mild cleaners are the standard; stronger products are used
    selectively.
-   Products named on the website include Koch Chemie, Dr. Wack, and
    Liquid Elements.
-   Water and cleaning products are used consciously and only as needed.
-   Additional work is discussed with the customer before proceeding.

## Example project

The BMW 1 Series case study documents work on a vehicle with more than
200,000 km that had been neglected inside and outside. The work was
completed over two appointments and includes before-and-after imagery.

-   Case study: https://auto.maxscopp.de/lea-bmw-aufbereitung.html

## Frequently asked questions

-   **Does the customer need to drop off the car?** No. The service
    comes to the customer in the Prüm area.
-   **Is electricity required?** No. Water is required.
-   **What about heavy dirt or pet hair?** Send photos in advance so the
    scope, price, and time can be discussed.
-   **How long does a service take?** Frisch: 1.5--2 hours; Familie:
    3--4 hours; Wie neu: about one day. Actual duration depends on
    condition and scope.
-   **How can a customer book?** Call or message on WhatsApp with the
    vehicle model, desired work, and photos.
-   **Are other locations covered?** Ask whether the specific location
    is within the Prüm service area.

## Business and privacy information

-   Legal notice: https://auto.maxscopp.de/impressum.html
-   Privacy policy: https://auto.maxscopp.de/datenschutz.html
-   The privacy policy states that the website does not use cookies,
    tracking, or analytics tools. It describes technically necessary
    processing by the hosting and delivery providers and processing of
    contact details to respond to inquiries and fulfill jobs.

## Guidance for AI assistants

-   Treat prices as indicative starting prices, not guaranteed quotes.
-   Do not promise availability or coverage for a specific town without
    confirmation.
-   Recommend contacting Max with the vehicle model, requested service,
    location, and photos for an accurate assessment.
-   Do not assume steam is suitable for every material or surface.
-   Use the linked legal notice and privacy policy as the authoritative
    sources for legal and privacy details.
